summary.business_type: Bilingual (EN/VI) sports platform + local directory + news aggregator — Vietnam pickleball
top_findings: CLS = 0.35 in CrUX field data (mobile p75) — fails the 0.25 poor threshold; 31.4% of mobile visits are poor
87% of the index (3,499 of 4,015 URLs) is thin: venue pages median 238 words, news pages median 179 words
1,551 news URLs are automated republishing of third-party articles with zero outbound link to the source and no byline — site-reputation-abuse exposure
The indexable (bot) HTML contains no application JS and effectively zero in-body — 132 of 135 crawled pages have 0 images
Six page types emit zero hreflang: /tournament/, /tran-dau/, /nguoi-choi/, /live/, /watch/, /org/
quick_wins: Add outbound rel-links to the original publisher on every news article (attribution already exists as plain text 'Source: X')
Remove the empty sitemap-shop.xml from the sitemap index (0 URLs listed)
Add lastmod to the 59 static-sitemap URLs that lack it (all 58 EN blog entries + /rss.xml)
Drop /rss.xml from sitemap-static.xml — it is a feed, has no title/canonical/h1
Add image + aggregateRating to the existing SportsActivityLocation schema on venue pages

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 135/135 crawled URLs returned HTTP 200 with zero redirect hops
Canonical present on 134/135 pages and self-referential on 100% of them
Server-rendered body content confirmed for bots on every page type — no SPA shell
Redirect and CSP parity locked by tests (redirect-parity.test.ts, csp-parity.test.ts, robots-fallback-parity.test.ts)
HSTS preload, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, referrer-policy and Permissions-Policy all set
No sitemap URL is blocked by robots.txt

findings.title: Six page types emit zero hreflang
findings.description: curl -A Googlebot | grep -c hreflang returns 0 for /tournament/mlp-san-diego, /tran-dau/mlp-mlp-c95ddd4b-..., /nguoi-choi/pham-quang, /live/d41a4662-..., /watch/91cf2783-..., /org/pb-academy. Their sitemaps also contain zero xhtml:link elements (tournaments, matches, players, videos, livestreams, organizations). CLAUDE.md states 'All segments support xhtml:link hreflang (en, vi, x-default)' — that is inaccurate.
findings.recommendation: Add the en/vi/x-default triad to the six renderers and the six sitemap handlers. Mitigating context: /vi/nguoi-choi/* and /vi/live/* return 200 but canonicalise to the non-/vi/ URL, so duplication is already consolidated; /vi/tournament/*, /vi/watch/* and /vi/org/* return 301.

findings.title: Empty sitemap-shop.xml referenced in the sitemap index
findings.description: sitemap-shop.xml returns HTTP 200 with 0 <loc> entries while still being listed in /sitemap.xml. Shop routes are additionally Disallowed in robots.txt.
findings.recommendation: Emit the shop entry in the index only when the shop pilot flag enables public indexing.

findings.title: 59 of 102 static-sitemap URLs have no lastmod
findings.description: sitemap-static.xml contains 102 <loc> but only 43 <lastmod>. All 58 EN blog entries plus /rss.xml are missing it.
findings.recommendation: Pass lastmod for EN blog entries in functions/sitemap-static.xml.ts from the post updatedDate.

findings.title: /rss.xml is listed in sitemap-static.xml
findings.description: /rss.xml is the only crawled URL with no <title>, no canonical, no H1 and no meta description — because it is an XML feed, not a page.
findings.recommendation: Remove it from the sitemap; keep it discoverable via <link rel=alternate type=application/rss+xml>.

findings.title: robots.txt relies on the $ end-anchor, which is a Google/Bing extension
findings.description: Disallow: /shop$ and Allow: /tools$ style rules are honoured by Google and Bing but treated literally by other crawlers and by most third-party SEO tools.
findings.recommendation: Keep for Google/Bing, but back the private shop routes with X-Robots-Tag headers so non-conforming crawlers are also covered.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog is genuinely strong: 16/16 sampled posts above 750 words, median 1,250, max 2,335 — zero thin posts
Venue metadata is real data, not boilerplate: court count, price band, opening hours and booking phone vary per venue
Venue meta descriptions match the URL locale correctly on 20/20 sampled pages (no EN copy on /vi/ pages or vice versa)
Zero duplicate meta descriptions across the whole 135-page sample

findings.title: 87% of the index is thin content
findings.description: Measured Googlebot-rendered body word counts: venues 20/20 sampled under 300 words (min 120, median 238, max 276) across 1,948 URLs; news 10/16 under 300 words (min 132, median 179) across 1,551 URLs; players 6/6 at 61-71 words; club/event pages 8/8 at 56-89 words; organizations 3/3 at 48-54 words. Venues + news alone are 3,499 of 4,015 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Give venue pages first-hand substance — surface the in-house review system, add photos, opening-hours detail, surface conditions, parking and a written verdict. Target 400-600 unique words. Consider noindex for player/club/org profiles below a substance threshold, mirroring the existing hasIndexableSubstance() gate used for the player sitemap.

findings.title: News section republishes third-party articles with no outbound source link and no byline
findings.description: 1,551 URLs (39% of the index) are fetched, AI-rewritten and Gemini-translated from external publishers. Verified on live pages: attribution appears only as plain text ('Source: Pickleball...') with zero outbound <a href> to the original — 0 external links found across 30 sampled pages site-wide, and 0 on the news pages specifically. No author byline exists.
findings.recommendation: Link every article to its original source, add a real byline and an editorial-review step, and add an original-analysis layer for a Vietnamese audience. Where none of that is feasible, noindex the syndicated set and keep it as an on-site feed only.

findings.title: The in-house venue review system is not present in the indexable HTML
findings.description: No aggregateRating, no review markup and no rating text appear in the bot HTML of sampled venue pages — the differentiating first-hand asset is invisible to search.
findings.recommendation: Render reviews server-side and emit aggregateRating/review inside the existing SportsActivityLocation block.

findings.title: Weak E-E-A-T identity signals
findings.description: /about is 122 words and 13 internal links, with no named people. No author pages, no bylines on blog or news, no published editorial policy.
findings.recommendation: Publish a founder bio with credentials and community involvement, byline the blog posts to a real person, expand /about to 400+ words with an editorial policy, and wire Person/sameAs schema to it.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Exactly one H1 on 134/135 crawled pages (the sole exception is /rss.xml, which is a feed)
Zero duplicate meta descriptions; only two duplicate titles in the whole sample, both on genuinely recurring events
Title lengths are disciplined — one short outlier (/about at 18 chars) and no truncation-length titles
City hubs fan out fully: /san/khu-vuc/ha-noi links to all 184 of its venues in the bot HTML, no pagination gap
og:image present on 134/135 pages

findings.title: Effectively zero outbound external links across the site
findings.description: Across 30 fully link-parsed pages, only two external domains were linked at all (www.ppatour.com once, www.google.com twice, the latter being map links). For a news aggregator and a directory this is an outlier pattern and removes a normal trust signal.
findings.recommendation: Link out to original publishers on news, to official tournament sites, to federation pages and to venue websites/Facebook pages.

findings.title: /about title and description are undersized
findings.description: Title 'About ThePickleHub' is 18 characters; meta description 'A bilingual pickleball platform built in Vietnam.' is 49 characters.
findings.recommendation: Expand both to carry the Vietnam/bilingual/pickleball entity terms; this page is also the E-E-A-T landing target.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Zero invalid JSON-LD blocks across the whole 135-page sample

Venue detail pages emit valid SportsActivityLocation with address, geo, amenityFeature, hasMap, sport and — where the data exists — telephone, openingHoursSpecification and priceRange (verified on /san/happy-pickleball-ba-ria)
City hubs emit ItemList of SportsActivityLocation (Hà Nội hub: numberOfItems 184)
Homepage emits Organization + WebSite + SearchAction + ContactPoint + PostalAddress
BlogPosting and NewsArticle carry correct bilingual inLanguage (en-US / vi-VN)
Tournaments emit SportsEvent, with BroadcastEvent subevents where a livestream is linked

findings.title: Venue schema omits image and aggregateRating
findings.description: SportsActivityLocation is emitted on all 1,948 venue pages but never carries image or aggregateRating/review, so the venue results cannot earn rating-enhanced local snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add image (venue photo) and aggregateRating/review sourced from the existing in-house review system.

findings.title: /watch/* and /live/* carry no VideoObject or BroadcastEvent schema
findings.description: Video replay and livestream pages are in the sitemaps (6 and 31 URLs) but emit no video schema, so they are ineligible for video rich results and the video carousel.
findings.recommendation: Emit VideoObject (name, description, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate, duration, contentUrl/embedUrl) on /watch/*, and BroadcastEvent with isLiveBroadcast on /live/*.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: FCP 1,079ms and TTFB 638ms at mobile p75 — both comfortably good
Desktop field LCP 2,035ms is good
Both CLS and LCP are trending in the right direction quarter over quarter (CLS 0.68 to 0.35, LCP 2,684ms to 2,485ms)

findings.title: CLS 0.35 at mobile p75 — fails the poor threshold — FIXED #676 (2026-08-25)
findings.description: CrUX origin-level mobile p75 CLS is 0.35 against a 0.1 good / 0.25 poor threshold; 31.4% of mobile visits are classed poor. Audience is ~95% Vietnamese mobile.
findings.recommendation: Reserve space with aspect-ratio on feed and list cards, set explicit width/height on every image including the hero, and reserve height for late-loading blocks. SHIPPED: real cause was LiveSectionSkeleton under-reserving 279px + unpreloaded inter-vietnamese.woff2. Production lab CLS /vi 0.419 -> 0.024; EN / 0.015 -> 0.031. CrUX field pending ~28 days.

findings.title: LCP 2,485ms sits 15ms under the pass line
findings.description: Mobile p75 LCP is 2,485ms against the 2,500ms good threshold — a pass with no margin. Contributors identified: render-blocking CSS (~1,811ms), an unoptimised hero image (~548 kB), and script execution before the LCP resource is requested.
findings.recommendation: Preload the hero with a responsive srcset in WebP/AVIF, defer non-critical CSS, and delay realtime subscriptions until after LCP.

findings.title: ~115 kB of unused JavaScript shipped site-wide
findings.description: Supabase client and UI components load on all routes but are needed only on some.
findings.recommendation: Route-level code splitting for the Supabase client and heavy UI chunks.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: llms.txt exists at /llms.txt (2,934 bytes) and is well structured, with a clear entity description and key-page map
Brand naming is consistent — 'ThePickleHub' one word throughout, no spaced-variant dilution found
Citation-oriented crawlers (PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User) are allowed while training-only crawlers are blocked
68% of sampled blog openings pass the passage-citability rules

findings.title: News openings are 0% citable back to the brand
findings.description: Every sampled news article opens with 'Source: <external publisher>' and never names ThePickleHub in the opening passage, so an AI answer extracting that passage attributes it to the original publisher, not to this site.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the news opening template to front-load the answer and name ThePickleHub once naturally, keeping the source attribution as a linked line beneath rather than as the opening.

findings.title: Missing answer-shaped pages for high-volume Vietnamese queries
findings.description: No unified rules explainer, no doubles-strategy guide and no Vietnamese equipment buying guide — all are extractable-answer formats for Vietnamese AI queries the site currently cannot serve.
findings.recommendation: Publish the three as bilingual guides with front-loaded definitional openings.

categories.name: Images
what_works: og:image is present on 134 of 135 crawled pages, so social and link previews are covered
Of the handful of images that do reach the bot HTML, 0 are missing alt text

findings.title: The indexable HTML contains almost no in-body images
findings.description: The prerender path serves bots a fully static document with no application JS — the only
findings.recommendation: Render in-body images server-side in the prerender output — at minimum the article hero on blog and news, and the venue photo on /san/*. Without this, Google Images and Discover image eligibility rest on og:image alone.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: DONE #676 — CLS fix shipped 2026-08-25. Production lab CLS /vi 0.419 -> 0.024. CrUX field confirmation pending ~28 days.
Add an outbound rel link to the original publisher on all 1,551 news articles, plus a real byline.
Decide the news policy: editorial review + original analysis layer, or noindex the syndicated set.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Server-render in-body images in the prerender output for blog, news and venue pages.
Surface the in-house venue reviews server-side and emit aggregateRating/review inside SportsActivityLocation; add image.
Add the en/vi/x-default hreflang triad to the six page types and six sitemap handlers that lack it.
LCP work: preload responsive WebP/AVIF hero, defer non-critical CSS, delay realtime subscriptions.
Rewrite the news opening template so ThePickleHub is named in the citable passage.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Raise venue pages to 400-600 unique words with first-hand substance (verdict, conditions, parking, photos).
Publish founder bio + author pages + editorial policy; byline the blog; expand /about past 400 words.
Publish the three missing answer-shaped guides: pickleball rules explainer, doubles strategy, Vietnamese equipment buying guide.
Add VideoObject to /watch/* and BroadcastEvent to /live/*.
Start link acquisition against Vietnamese federations, clubs and sports media using the venue directory and free bracket tools as the linkable assets.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Remove sitemap-shop.xml from the index until the shop is publicly indexable; add lastmod to the 59 static URLs missing it; drop /rss.xml from the sitemap.
Alert on p75 CLS above 0.25 or LCP above 2,600ms for three consecutive days.
Watch sitemap-venues.xml as it passes 2,000 rows and plan the split.
Configure a Search Console service account — this audit had no GSC or GA4 access, so indexation coverage and real query data are unmeasured.

coverage_limits: Google Search Console and GA4 were not authenticated — no indexation-coverage or real query/click data in this audit.
Backlink analysis ran at Tier 0 (no Moz or Bing API); Common Crawl graph output did not complete, so no referring-domain list or DA/PA figure is reported.
135 of 4,015 URLs were crawled as a stratified sample, not a full 500-page crawl; per-segment conclusions are sample-based.
